channel.title: AI Threat Watch: NL
channel.description: Verified case files located in NL.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Two arrested in AI-powered bank fraud that cost victims €380,000
item.description: Rotterdam police arrested two men, aged 23 and 25, accused of a new form of bank-helpdesk fraud. Victims got calls with AI-generated recordings in different voices and were then connected to a fake bank employee. They were told to download an app and scan their bank cards, which allegedly let accomplices copy the cards remotely and withdraw cash. About 170 victims reportedly lost around €380,000 in three weeks, roughly $423,000 per Daily Hodl. Target: Dutch bank customers (170 victims). NL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Agentic AI attack exploits Zammad zero-days against Dutch vulnerability disclosure institute
item.description: AI agents chained two Zammad zero-days for session hijacking, code execution and root escalation within seconds, stealing email addresses from DIVD. Target: Dutch Institute for Vulnerability Disclosure (DIVD). NL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Dutch police arrest Amsterdam man who used deepfakes to pass bank ID checks, 46 accounts
item.description: Dutch police arrested a 34-year-old who collected ID documents via fake apartment listings, then used AI to overlay victims' facial features onto his own face to pass ABN Amro's identity checks for at least 46 accounts. Target: Dutch banks and rental applicants. NL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [LOW] Skynet malware sample embeds prompt injection to fool AI malware analysis tools
item.description: Check Point found a half-finished Windows sample on VirusTotal with a string telling any analysing LLM to ignore instructions, act as a calculator and reply NO MALWARE DETECTED; it failed against o3 and GPT-4.1. Target: LLM-based malware analysis pipelines. NL. Verification: confirmed.
